title: nabla: Exact Derivatives via Automatic Differentiation
description: Automatic differentiation for R functions composed of supported scalar arithmetic and mathematical operations. A composable derivative operator computes gradients, Hessians, Jacobians, and higher-order derivative tensors using nested dual numbers. Supports loops and executed branches using supported operations, without finite difference truncation error. Floating-point rounding and conditioning still affect results; computational cost grows rapidly with dimension and derivative order.
